posts.title: Cybersecurity Architecture for Agentic Software
posts.description: The command-control patterns, agent identity, permission scoping, append-only audit, egress boundaries, and kill switches required before AI agents touch real infrastructure.
posts.author: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
posts.pullQuote: Alignment is a probability. Architecture is a guarantee.

posts.title: The OSINT Workflow That Survives Contact With Reality
posts.description: Collection planning, machine-enforceable source grading, entity resolution without hallucinated merges, claim lineage, and analyst review loops that don't drown in noise.
posts.author: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
posts.pullQuote: The pipeline's job is not to find the truth. It is to make the analyst's disbelief cheap and the system's mistakes reversible.

posts.title: ClearGlassInc Artemis: The Self-Evolving AI Intelligence Platform

posts.author: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
